_comment: The Print Outs station reads this at runtime (tools/printouts/index.html). Add a file to printouts/ and add a row here — the page needs no code change. `bytes` is a hint for the row's size label; the station prefers the real Content-Length when the server gives it one.

groups.label: Customer-Facing Collateral
groups.blurb: The paper that goes across the counter — hand it to the customer or hold it up while you sell.

groups.label: Store Operations
groups.blurb: The sheets that run the day: open it, work it, close it, log the cash.

groups.label: Reference & HR
groups.blurb: What you print once and keep — policy, payout, survey wording, and the links you always hunt for.

files.label: Welcome Kit — Xfinity
files.blurb: Hand this to every new Xfinity customer at the close — what they bought, what happens next, and who to call.

files.label: Google Review Print Out
files.blurb: Four review cards per page, one page per store — print your store's page, cut, and hand one over at the close. The QR code goes straight to that store's Google review.

files.label: NPS Start/Stop QR Codes
files.blurb: Opt-in and opt-out cards for Xfinity text updates — 27 pages, one per store, four cards to a page with cut marks. Scan START to turn texts on, STOP to turn them off.

files.label: Channel Line Up
files.blurb: The full Xfinity TV lineup — print it when a customer wants to see their channel on paper before they say yes.

files.file: Now TV - Now Latino - Channel Guide.pdf
files.label: Now TV — Now Latino Channel Guide
files.blurb: The Now Latino channel guide for the Now TV pitch — the Spanish-language lineup, ready to hand over.

files.label: Daily Menu — Sales Tracker
files.blurb: Today's board: print it at open and track the store against goal as the sales land.

files.label: Brinks Pick-Up Log
files.blurb: Post it by the safe and sign every Brinks pickup as it happens — date, bag, amount, initials.

files.label: Employee Handbook
files.blurb: The January 2026 edition — policy, dress code, time off, and the answers to what reps ask HR first.

files.label: NPS — Black and White
files.blurb: The toner-friendly NPS sheet — the survey ask spelled out, for the counter or the back-office wall.

files.label: NPS Text Template — Spanish
files.blurb: The Spanish wording for the survey follow-up text, so a Spanish-speaking customer knows what the score means.
